items.title: Apple overtakes Nvidia as most valuable company as iPhone maker avoids 'capex pitfalls'
items.summary: Apple stock has climbed more than 22% year to date, with investors rewarding the iPhone maker for its capex-light approach to AI spending.

items.title: 4 Big Tech earnings reports, a Fed meeting, and $100 oil: It's the busiest week of the quarter
items.summary: Investors step into the busiest week of the quarter with hyperscaler earnings, the June Fed meeting, and escalations in the Middle East all in focus.

items.title: Tesla Stock Breaks Down After Worst Week Since 2022, Charts Point to $296
items.summary: Tesla stock broke down from a parallel channel after an 18% weekly drop. Charts now point to $296, with $260 below.

items.title: Cathie Wood Goes Bargain Hunting: 3 Huge Stocks She Bought Last Week
items.summary: Three megacaps that fell sharply last week have been on growth investors' radars in recent days.

items.title: This Bearish Put Spread Can Cash In On Tesla Stock's Bleak Outlook
items.summary: For investors who want to cash in on further weakness in Tesla stock, they can consider using a bear put spread.

items.title: Ford, General Motors Upgraded On Profit, Cash Flow Outlooks. One Eyes A Buy Point.
items.summary: Jefferies upgraded Ford and General Motors as they moved past last year's electric vehicle losses. Ford stock rose about 1%, while General Motors advanced around 2.5%.

items.title: Ford, PACCAR, OSK & ABG: Can They Beat Q2 Earnings Estimates?
items.summary: F, PCAR, OSK and ABG face mixed Q2 setups as softer volumes, tariffs and pricing pressures cloud their chances of beating estimates.

items.title: Tesla Stock Just Erased a Year of Gains. Nothing Seems to Help.
items.summary: Tesla  stock was declining Monday—again—and nothing seems to help.  Tesla stock dropped 18% last week, including a near-15% drop on Thursday after the company reported weaker-than-expected second-quarter results.  Tesla reported an operating profit of about $400 million.
